G2618.def:
**κατα-καίω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in [[Exo.3.2|Exo.3:2]] (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω ;]
**to burn up, burn completely**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.13.30|Mat.13:30]] [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]]; pass., [[1Co.3.15|1Co.3:15]], [[Heb.13.11|Heb.13:11]], [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], [[Rev.8.7|Rev.8:7]]; before πυρί [[Mat.3.12; 13.40|Mat.3:12 13:40]], [[Luk.3.17|Luk.3:17]] (cf. [[Exo.29.14|Exo.29:14]], al.); ἐν πυρί ([[Deu.9.21|Deu.9:21]], al.): [[Rev.17.16; 18.8|Rev.17:16 18:8]].†
(AS)

G2641.def:
**κατα-λείπω **
[in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;]
1 1, **to leave behind, leave**: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), [[Mat.4.13|Mat.4:13]], [[Mrk.12.19, 21|Mrk.12:19, 21]], [[Luk.20.31|Luk.20:31]], [[Act.24.27; 25.14|Act.24:27 25:14]], [[Heb.11.27|Heb.11:27]]; of sailing by a place, [[Act.21.3|Act.21:3]] ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, _Words_, 21 f.), [[Mat.16.4; 21.17|Mat.16:4 21:17]]; pass., [[Jhn.8.9|Jhn.8:9]], [[1Th.3.1|1Th.3:1]]; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, [[2Pe.2.15|2Pe.2:15]]
2. **to forsake, abandon**: [[Mat.19.5|Mat.19:5]], [[Mrk.10.7|Mrk.10:7]]" (LXX) [[Mrk.14.52|Mrk.14:52]], [[Luk.5.28; 15.4|Luk.5:28 15:4]], [[Act.6.2|Act.6:2]], [[Eph.5.31|Eph.5:31]]" (LXX) .
3. **to leave remaining, reserve**: with accusative and inf., [[Luk.10.40|Luk.10:40]] ἐμαυτῷ, [[Rom.11.4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX); pass., [[Heb.4.1|Heb.4:1]] (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).†
(AS)

G2662.def:
**κατα-πατέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;]
**to tread down, trample under foot**: [[Mat.7.6|Mat.7:6]], [[Luk.12.1|Luk.12:1]]; pass., [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]], [[Luk.8.5|Luk.8:5]]. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, [[Heb.10.29|Heb.10:29]]†
(AS)

G2647.def:
**κατα-λύω **
[in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
1. **to destroy, cast down**: [[Mat.24.2|Mat.24:2]], [[Mrk.13.2|Mrk.13:2]], [[Luk.21.6|Luk.21:6]]; τ. ναόν, [[Mat.26.61; 27.40|Mat.26:61 27:40]], [[Mrk.14.58; 15.29|Mrk.14:58 15:29]], [[Act.6.14|Act.6:14]]; οἰκίαν, [[2Co.5.1|2Co.5:1]] opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, [[Gal.2.18|Gal.2:18]] Metaphorical, **to overthrow, annul, abrogate**: [[Act.5.38-39;|Act.5:38-39]] τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.14.20|Rom.14:20]] τ. νόμον, [[Mat.5.17|Mat.5:17]] ([[2Ma.2.22|2Ma.2:22]]).
2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., [[Gen.19.2|Gen.19:2]], al.): [[Luk.9.12; 19.7|Luk.9:12 19:7]].†
(AS)

G2648.def:
**κατα-μανθάνω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.34.1|Gen.34:1]] (רָאָה), [[Job.35.4|Job.35:4]] (5) (שׁוּר), [[Sir.9.5|Sir.9:5]], 8, al. ;]
**to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully **(on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, _Pr._, 117): [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]]†
(AS)

G2657.def:
**κατα-νοέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;]
**to take note of, perceive, consider carefully**: [[Act.7.31-32;|Act.7:31-32]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.7.3|Mat.7:3]], [[Luk.6.41; 12.24, 27; 20.23|Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23]], [[Act.11.6; 27.39|Act.11:6 27:39]], [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.3.1; 10.24|Heb.3:1 10:24]], [[Jas.1.23-24|Jas.1:23-24]] (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, _Pr._, 117).†
(AS)

G2682.def:
**κατα-σκήνωσις**, εως, ἡ
[in LXX: [[1Ch.28.2|1Ch.28:2]] (בָּנָה), [[Ezk.37.27|Eze.37:27]] (מִשְׁכָּן) [[Tob.1.4|Tob.1:4]], [[Wis.9.8|Wis.9:8]], [[2Ma.14.35|2Ma.14:35]] (R)* ;]
1. prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with).
2. **a lodging, abode**: of birds, [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], [[Luk.9.58|Luk.9:58]].†
(AS)

G2606.def:
**κατα-γελάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, [[Job.5.22|Job.5:22]], [[Pro.29.9|Pro.29:9]], al. ;]
**to deride, laugh scornfully at**: with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.9.24|Mat.9:24]], [[Mrk.5.40|Mrk.5:40]], [[Luk.8.53|Luk.8:53]].†
(AS)

G2680.def:
**κατα-σκευάζω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.40.19, 28|Isa.40:19, 28]], (בָּרָא), etc. ;]
**to prepare, make ready**: τ. ὁδόν, [[Mat.11.10|Mat.11:10]], [[Mrk.1.2|Mrk.1:2]], [[Luk.7.27|Luk.7:27]]; οἶκον, [[Heb.3.3-4;|Heb.3:3-4]] σκηνήν, [[Heb.9.2|Heb.9:2]], 6; κιβωτόν, [[Heb.11.7|Heb.11:7]], [[1Pe.3.20|1Pe.3:20]]; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]]†
(AS)

G2613.def:
**κατα-δικάζω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.94.21|Psa.94:21]] (רָשַׁע hi.), [[Lam.3.36|La 3:36]] (עָוַת pi.), [[Wis.2.20|Wis.2:20]], al. ;]
**to pass sentence upon, condemn**; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): [[Mat.12.7|Mat.12:7]], [[Jas.5.6|Jas.5:6]]; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), [[Luk.6.37|Luk.6:37]] pass., [[Mat.12.37|Mat.12:37]], [[Luk.6.37|Luk.6:37]].†
δικάζω,
**to judge**: [[Luk.6.37|Luk.6:37]] (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).†
(AS)

G2608.def:
**κατ-άγνυμι **
[in LXX for נָחַת pi., etc. ;]
**to break**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.12.20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX), [[Jhn.19.31-33|Jhn.19:31-33]]†
(AS)

G2632.def:
**κατα-κρίνω **
[in LXX: [[Est.2.1|Est.2:1]] (גָּזַר ni.), [[Wis.4.16|Wis.4:16]], Dan LXX TH [[Sus.1.53; 4.34|Sus 1:53, 4:34]], TH [[Sus.1.41,48,53|Sus 1:41,48,53]]* ;]
**to give judgment against, condemn**: [[Rom.8.34|Rom.8:34]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.14.64|Mrk.14:64]], [[Jhn.8.10-11|Jhn.8:10-11]]; disting. fr. κρίνειν, [[Rom.2.1|Rom.2:1]], [[1Co.11.32|1Co.11:32]]; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), [[Mat.20.18|Mat.20:18]], [[Mrk.10.33|Mrk.10:33]]; pass., [[Mat.27.3|Mat.27:3]], [[Mrk.16.16|Mrk.16:16]], [[Rom.14.23|Rom.14:23]], [[1Co.11.32|1Co.11:32]], [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]]. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: [[Mat.12.41-42|Mat.12:41-42]], [[Luk.11.31-32|Luk.11:31-32]], [[Rom.8.3|Rom.8:3]], [[Heb.11.7|Heb.11:7]] †
(AS)

G2681.def:
**κατα-σκηνόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;]
**to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell**: before ἐν, [[Mat.13.32|Mat.13:32]], [[Luk.13.19|Luk.13:19]]; ὑπό, with accusative, [[Mrk.4.32|Mrk.4:32]] ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, [[Act.2.26|Act.2:26]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2602.def:
**κατα-βολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταβάλλω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.2.29|2Ma.2:29]] * ;]
1. **a laying down**: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, [[Heb.11.11|Heb.11:11]] (EV, to conceive seed).
2. **a foundation **(of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, [[Mat.13.35|Mat.13:35]] (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), [[Mat.25.34|Mat.25:34]], [[Luk.11.50|Luk.11:50]], [[Heb.4.3; 9.26|Heb.4:3 9:26]], [[Rev.13.8; 17.8|Rev.13:8 17:8]]; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, [[Jhn.17.24|Jhn.17:24]], [[Eph.1.4|Eph.1:4]], [[1Pe.1.20|1Pe.1:20]].†
(AS)

G2670.def:
**κατα-πονίζω **
[in LXX for טָבַע pu., [[Exo.15.4|Exo.15:4]] A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, [[Psa.55.9; 69.2|Psa.55:9 69:2]], al. ;]
**to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein**: [[Mat.14.30|Mat.14:30]] pass., [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]]†
(AS)

G2690.def:
**κατα-στρέφω **
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., [[Gen.19.21|Gen.19:21]], [[Jer.20.16|Jer.20:16]], al. ;]
1. **to turn down, turn over**; as, the soil.
2. **to overturn, overthrow**: [[Mat.21.12|Mat.21:12]], [[Mrk.11.15|Mrk.11:15]]; pass. pf. ptcp., [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2666.def:
**κατα-πίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;]
1. **to drink down, swallow**: [[Mat.23.24|Mat.23:24]], [[Rev.12.16|Rev.12:16]].
2. **to devour**: [[1Pe.5.8|1Pe.5:8]] Metaphorical, **to swallow up, consume**: pass., [[1Co.15.54|1Co.15:54]] (LXX), [[2Co.2.7; 5.4|2Co.2:7 5:4]], [[Heb.11.29|Heb.11:29]].†
(AS)

G2627.def:
**κατα-κλυσμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κατακλύζω), [in LXX chiefly for מַבּוּל, [[Gen.6.17|Gen.6:17]], al.; also for שֶׁטֶף, [[Psa.32.6|Psa.32:6]], al. ;]
**a flood, deluge**: [[Mat.24.38-39|Mat.24:38-39]] [[Luk.17.27|Luk.17:27]], [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]].†
(AS)

G2672.def:
**κατ-αράομαι**, -ώμαι depon.
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;]
**to curse**: with accusative, [[Mrk.11.21|Mrk.11:21]] opposite to εὐλογέω, [[Luk.6.26|Luk.6:26]], [[Rom.12.14|Rom.12:14]], [[Jas.3.9|Jas.3:9]]; pass. pf. ptcp., **accursed, under a curse **(see M, _Pr._, 221): [[Mat.25.41|Mat.25:41]]†
(AS)

G2649.def:
**κατα-μαρτυρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Job.15.6|Job.15:6]], [[Pro.25.18|Pro.25:18]] (עָנָה), al. ;]
**to bear witness againt**: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), [[Mat.26.62; 27.13|Mat.26:62 27:13]], [[Mrk.14.60|Mrk.14:60]].†
(AS)

G2665.def:
**κατα-πέτασμα**, -τος, τό
(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), [[Exo.26.31|Exo.26:31]], [[Lev.21.23|Lev.21:23]], al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), [[Exo.35.12|Exo.35:12]], Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;]
**in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple **(or Tabernacle): [[Mat.27.51|Mat.27:51]], [[Mrk.15.38|Mrk.15:38]], [[Luk.23.45|Luk.23:45]], [[Heb.6.19; 9.3|Heb.6:19 9:3]]; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ [[Heb.10.20|Heb.10:20]]†
(AS)

G2621.def:
**κατά-κειμαι **
[in LXX: [[Pro.6.9; 23.34|Pro.6:9 23:34]] (שָׁכַב), [[Jdt.13.15|Jdth.13:15]], [[Wis.17.7|Wis.17:7]] * ;]
1. to lie down.
2. **to lie sick**: [[Mrk.1.30; 2.4|Mrk.1:30 2:4]], [[Jhn.5.6|Jhn.5:6]], [[Act.28.8|Act.28:8]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[Act.9.33|Act.9:33]] id. with accusative, [[Luk.5.25|Luk.5:25]] ἐν, [[Jhn.5.3|Jhn.5:3]]
3. **to recline at meals **(cf. ἀνάιειμαι): [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]], [[Luk.5.29|Luk.5:29]]; before ἐν, [[Mrk.2.15|Mrk.2:15]], [[Luk.7.37|Luk.7:37]], [[1Co.8.10|1Co.8:10]].†
(AS)

G2614.def:
**κατα-διώκω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;]
"perfective" compound (M, _Pr._, 116), to pursue closely, follow up
(a) with hostile intent (Thuc., i, 49, [[Gen.31.36|Gen.31:36]] al.);
(b) with kindly intention ([[Psa.23.6|Psa.23:6]], [[1Sa.30.22|1Ki.30:22]], cf. [[Sir.27.17|Sir.27:17]]): [[Mrk.1.36|Mrk.1:36]].†
(AS)

G2629.def:
**κατα-κόπτω **
[in LXX for נָכָה hi., כָּתַת pi., etc. ;]
to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. [[Isa.27.9|Isa.27:9]], [[Jer.21.7|Jer.21:7]], [[2Ch.34.7|2Ch.34:7]]): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, [[Mrk.5.5|Mrk.5:5]]†
(AS)

G2622.def:
**κατα-κλάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Ezk.19.12|Eze.19:12]] (נָתַשׁ hoph.)* ;]
**to break up, break in pieces**: [[Mrk.6.41|Mrk.6:41]], [[Luk.9.16|Luk.9:16]].†
(AS)

G2638.def:
**κατα-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;]
1. **to lap hold of, seize, appropriate**: [[Mrk.9.18|Mrk.9:18]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.9.24|1Co.9:24]], [[Php.3.12-13|Php.3:12-13]]
2. **to overtake**: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, _Notes_, 158 f.), [[Rom.9.30|Rom.9:30]] ἡ ἡμέρα, [[1Th.5.4|1Th.5:4]] of evils, [[Jhn.1.5; 12.35|Jhn.1:5 12:35]] (cf. 617 T); hence, **to surprise, discover**: [[Jhn.8.3-4|Jhn.8:3-4]]],
3. **Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend**; so mid., in NT (M, _Pr._, 158): [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]] before ὅτι, [[Act.4.13; 10.34|Act.4:13 10:34]]; with accusative and inf., [[Act.25.25|Act.25:25]] (MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2646.def:
**κατά-λυμα**, -τος, τό
(καταλύω), [in LXX: [[Exo.4.24|Exo.4:24]] (מָלוֹן), [[1Sa.9.22|1Ki.9:22]] (לִשְׁכָּה), etc. ;]
1. = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), **an inn, lodgingplace**: [[Luk.2.7|Luk.2:7]] (so Ex, l.with, and M_Gr._).
2. **a guest-room **(1Sam,l.with): [[Mrk.14.14|Mrk.14:14]], [[Luk.22.11|Luk.22:11]].†
(AS)

G2623.def:
**κατα-κλείω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.32.3|Jer.32:3]] (כָּלָא), [[Wis.17.2, 16|Wis.17:2, 16]], [[2Ma.13.21|2Ma.13:21]], [[3Ma.3.25|3Ma.3:25]] * ;]
**to shut up**:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), [[Luk.3.20|Luk.3:20]], [[Act.26.10|Act.26:10]].†
(AS)

G2630.def:
**κατα-κρημνίζω**
(κρημνός), [in LXX: [[2Ch.25.12|2Ch.25:12]] (שָׁלַךְ hi.), [[2Ma.12.15|2Ma.12:15]] [[2Mac.14.43|2Mac 14:43]], [[4Ma.4.25|4Ma.4:25]]*.]
**to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long**: [[Luk.4.29|Luk.4:29]]†
(AS)

G2656.def:
**κατα-νεύω **
1. **to nod assent, **
2. **to make a sign by nodding the head**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]]†
(AS)

G2609.def:
**κατ-άγω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;]
**to bring down**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.22.30|Act.22:30]], [[Rom.10.6|Rom.10:6]]; id. before εἰς, [[Act.9.30; 23.15, 20; 23.28|Act.9:30 23:15, 20 23:28]]; as nautical term, **to bring to land**: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[Luk.5.11|Luk.5:11]] pass., before εἰς, [[Act.27.3; 2.12|Act.27:3 2:12]].†
(AS)

G2625.def:
**κατα-κλίνω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.21.18|Exo.21:18]] (נָפַל), [[Num.24.9|Num.24:9]], [[Jdg.5.27|Jdg.5:27]], [[1Sa.16.11|1Ki.16:11]] (כָּרַע), [[Jdt.12.15|Jdth.12:15]], [[3Ma.1.3|3Ma.1:3]] * ;]
to lay down, make to lie down, esp. for meals: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.9.14-15;|Luk.9:14-15]] mid., **to recline at meals**: [[Luk.7.36; 24.30|Luk.7:36 24:30]]; before εἰς, [[Luk.14.8|Luk.14:8]] (cf. Jth, Lc.).†
(AS)

G2667.def:
**κατα-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.145.14|Psa.145:14]] (נָפַל), etc. ;]
**to fall down**: [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]] before εἰς, [[Act.26.14|Act.26:14]] ἐπί with accusative, [[Luk.8.6|Luk.8:6]]†
(AS)

G2668.def:
**κατα-πλέω**, -ῶ
**to sail down, sail to land, put in**: εἰς τ. χώραν, [[Luk.8.26|Luk.8:26]]†
(AS)

G2611.def:
**κατα-δέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for חָבַשׁ, etc. ;]
**to bind up**: τ. τραύματα (cf. [[Sir.27.21|Sir.27:21]]), [[Luk.10.34|Luk.10:34]].†
(AS)

G2694.def:
**κατα-σύρω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.49.10|Jer.49:10]] (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, [[Dan.11.10, 26|Dan.11:10, 26]] (שָׁטַף) * ;]
1. to pull down.
2. **to drag away**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]]†
(AS)

G2673.def:
**κατ-αργέω**, -ῶ
(κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), [in LXX: [[2Es.4.21|2Es.4.21]] [[2Es.4.23|2Es.4.23]] [[2Es.5.5|2Es.5.5]] [[2Es.6.8|2Es.6.8]] (בְּטֵל)* ;]
**to make idle or inactive **(χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, [[Luk.13.7|Luk.13:7]] Metaphorical (Inscr.), **to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish**: [[Rom.3.3, 31|Rom.3:3, 31]], [[1Co.1.28; 6.13; 13.11; 15.24|1Co.1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24]], [[Gal.3.17|Gal.3:17]], [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]], [[2Th.2.8|2Th.2:8]], [[2Ti.1.10|2Ti.1:10]], [[Heb.2.14|Heb.2:14]]; pass., [[Rom.4.14; 6.6|Rom.4:14 6:6]], [[1Co.2.6; 13.8; 13.10; 15.26|1Co.2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26]], [[2Co.3.7; 3.11-14|2Co.3:7 3:11-14]] [[Gal.5.11|Gal.5:11]]; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, [[Rom.7.2|Rom.7:2]], 6, [[Gal.5.4|Gal.5:4]].†
(AS)

G2617.def:
**κατ-αισχύνω **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;]
**to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame**: with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.11.4-5;|1Co.11:4-5]] with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.1.27; 11.22|1Co.1:27 11:22]]; pass., to be ashamed: [[Luk.13.17|Luk.13:17]], [[2Co.7.14; 9.4|2Co.7:14 9:4]], [[1Pe.3.16|1Pe.3:16]]; as in LXX ([[Psa.22.6; 25.2-3|Psa.22:6 25:2-3]], al.), of unfulfilled hopes: [[Rom.5.5|Rom.5:5]] pass., [[Rom.9.33; 10.11|Rom.9:33 10:11]], [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G2695.def:
**κατα-σφάζω **
[in LXX: [[Zec.11.5|Zec.11:5]] (הָרַג), [[Ezk.16.40|Eze.16:40]] (בָּתַק pi.), [[2Ma.8.1-36|2Ma.8:1-36]] ;]
**to kill off, slay**: with accusative, [[Luk.19.27|Luk.19:27]]†
(AS)

G2642.def:
**κατα-λιθάζω**
(= cl. -θόω; cf. -θοβολέω, [[Exo.17.4|Exo.17:4]], Num_14:10)
**to cast stones at, to stone**: [[Luk.20.6|Luk.20:6]]†
(AS)

G2661.def:
**κατ-αξιόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.13.12|2Ma.13:12]], [[3Ma.3.21|3Ma.3:21]] [[3Mac.4.11|3Mac 4:11]], [[4Ma.18.3|4Ma.18:3]] * ;]
**to deem worthy**: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[2Th.1.5|2Th.1:5]] pass. before inf., [[Luk.20.35|Luk.20:35]], [[Act.5.41|Act.5:41]].†
(AS)

G2628.def:
**κατ-ακολουθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Jer.17.16|Jer.17:16]] (רָאָה), [[1Ma.6.23|1Ma.6:23]], al. ;]
**to follow after**: [[Luk.23.55|Luk.23:55]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.16.17|Act.16:17]]†
(AS)

G2650.def:
**κατα-μένω **
[in LXX for יָשַׁב ([[Num.20.1|Num.20:1]], al.), etc. ;]
**to remain permanently, abide**: [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]], [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]], WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†
(AS)

G2674.def:
**κατ-αριθμέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ch.31.19|2Ch.31:19]] (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;]
**to number or count among**: before ἐν, [[Act.1.1|Act.1:1]]†
(AS)

G2660.def:
**κατα-νύσσω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.34.7|Gen.34:7]] (עָצַב hith.), [[Lev.10.3|Lev.10:3]], [[Psa.4.4|Psa.4:4]], [[Psa.29.12|Psa 29:12]], al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH [[Sus.1.10|Sus 1:10]] (רָדַם ni.), [[Sir.12.12; 14.1|Sir.12:12 14:1]], al. ;]
1. to strike or prick violently.
2. to stun.
3. Of strong emotion, pass., **to be smitten**: τὴν καρδίαν, [[Act.2.37|Act.2:37]] (see: κατάνυξις).†
(AS)

G2605.def:
**κατ-αγγέλλω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.17.5|Pro.17:5]] A, [[2Ma.8.36|2Ma.8:36]] [[2Mac.9.17|2Mac 9:17]] * ;]
1. **to pro­claim, declare**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.3.24; 16.21; 17.23|Act.3:24 16:21 17:23]]; τ. ἀνάστασιν, [[Act.4.2|Act.4:2]] τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., [[Act.13.5; 15.36|Act.13:5 15:36]]; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, [[Act.16.17|Act.16:17]] φῶς, [[Act.26.23|Act.26:23]] τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., [[1Co.2.1|1Co.2:1]] τ. εὐαγγέλιον, [[1Co.9.14|1Co.9:14]] τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., [[1Co.11.26|1Co.11:26]] pass., ἄφεσις, [[Act.13.33|Act.13:33]] ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., [[Act.17.13|Act.17:13]] ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, [[Rom.1.8|Rom.1:8]] with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, [[Act.17.3|Act.17:3]], [[Col.1.28|Col.1:28]]; τ. Χριστόν, [[Php.1.17|Php.1:17]] pass., [[Php.1.18|Php.1:18]]
2. **to denounce **(Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on [[1Jn.1.5|1Jn.1:5]] and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).†
(AS)

G2697.def:
**κατά-σχεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ]
1. a holding back.
2. **LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession**: [[Act.7.5, 45|Act.7:5, 45]].†
(AS)

G2686.def:
**κατα-σοφίζομαι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.1.10|Exo.1:10]] (חָכָם hith.), [[Jdt.5.11; 10.19|Jdth.5:11 10:19]] * ;]
**to deal craftily with, outwit**: [[Act.7.19|Act.7:19]] (LXX) †
(AS)

G2669.def:
**κατα-πονέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.8.2|2Ma.8:2]] (A), [[3Ma.2.2|3Ma.2:2]] [[3Mac.2.13|3Mac 2:13]] * ;]
**to wear down, oppress, treat hardly**: pass., [[Act.7.24|Act.7:24]], [[2Pe.2.7|2Pe.2:7]].†
(AS)

G2663.def:
**κατά-παυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, [[Psa.95.11|Psa.95:11]], [[Isa.66.1|Isa.66:1]], al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., [[2Ma.15.1|2Ma.15:1]]]
1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease.
2. **In LXX and NT, rest, repose**: [[Act.7.49|Act.7:49]] (LXX), [[Heb.3.11, 18; 4.1, 3; 4.5, 10-11|Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11]]†
(AS)

G2616.def:
**κατα-δυναστεύω **
[in LXX for יָנָה, עָשַׁק, etc. ;]
**to exercise power over, oppress**: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, [[Mic.2.2|Mic.2:2]], [[Wis.2.10|Wis.2:10]], al.); with genitive of person(s), [[Jas.2.6|Jas.2:6]] (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., [[Act.10.38|Act.10:38]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2678.def:
**κατα-σείω **
[in LXX: Da TH [[Bel.1.14|Bel 1:14]] AR, [[1Ma.6.38|1Ma.6:38]] * ;]
1. to shake down.
2. **Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal**: τ. χεῖρα, [[Act.19.33|Act.19:33]] τ. χειρί, [[Act.13.16|Act.13:16]] id. with dative of person(s), [[Act.21.40|Act.21:40]] before inf., [[Act.12.17|Act.12:17]]†
(AS)

G2624.def:
**κατα-κληρονομέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance ([[Num.34.18|Num.34:18]], [[Jos.14.1|Jos.14:1]], al.): [[Act.13.19|Act.13:19]].
2. to receive by inheritance ([[Deu.1.38|Deu.1:38]], al.).†
**κατα-κληροδοτέω**, ῶ,
[in LXX: [[Deu.1.38; 21.16|Deu.1:38 21:16]] A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), [[1Ma.3.36|1Ma.3:36]] א R (-νομέω, A)* ;]
[[Act.13.19|Act.13:19]], Rec., = -νομέω, which see†
(AS)

G2664.def:
**κατα-παύω **
[in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
1. trans.,
(a) **to cause to cease, restrain**: [[Act.14.18|Act.14:18]]
(b) **to cause to rest**: [[Heb.4.8|Heb.4:8]]
2. Intrans., **to rest**: before ἀτό, [[Heb.4.4|Heb.4:4]] (LXX), [[Heb.4.10|Heb.4:10]]†
(AS)

G2679.def:
**κατα-σκάπτω **
[in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;]
**to dig down**: [[Rom.11.3|Rom.11:3]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2645.def:
**κατά-λοιπος**, -ον
[in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;]
**left remaining**: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[Act.15.17|Act.15:17]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2658.def:
**κατ-αντάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Sa.3.29|2Ki.3:29]] (חוּל), [[2Ma.4.21|2Ma.4:21]] [[2Mac.4.24|2Mac 4:24]] [[2Mac.4.44|2Mac 4:44]] [[2Mac.6.14|2Mac 6:14]] * ;]
**to come to, arrive at**: before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[Act.16.1; 18.19, 24; 21.7; 25.13|Act.16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13]] (see M, _Pr._, 132) [[Act.27.12; 28.13|Act.27:12 28:13]]; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, [[Act.20.15|Act.20:15]] Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.10.11; 14.36|1Co.10:11 14:36]]; id. with accusative of thing(s), **to attain to**: [[Act.26.7|Act.26:7]], [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]], [[Php.3.11|Php.3:11]].†
(AS)

G2604.def:
**καταγγελεύς**, -έως, ὁ
**a proclaimer, herald **(in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., _LAE_, 97): with genitive obj., [[Act.17.18|Act.17:18]]†
(AS)

G2687.def:
**κατα-στέλλω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.4.31|2Ma.4:31]], [[3Ma.6.1|3Ma.6:1]] * ;]
1. to let down, lower.
2. **to keep down, restrain**: with accusative, [[Act.19.35-36|Act.19:35-36]] †
(AS)

G2698.def:
**κατα-τίθημι **
[in LXX: [[1Ch.21.27|1Ch.21:27]] שׁוּב hi.), [[Psa.41.8|Psa.41:8]] (יָצַק), [[1Ma.10.23|1Ma.10:23]], al. ;]
**to lay down, deposit, lay by**: [[Mrk.15.46|Mrk.15:46]], T; mid., **to lay up for oneself**: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), [[Act.24.27; 25.9|Act.24:27 25:9]].†
(AS)

G2637.def:
**κατά-λαλος**, -ου, ὁ
**a railer, defamer**: [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]]†
_SYN._: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., _Syn._, § cvii, 15; Lft., _Notes_, 256) (AS)

G2644.def:
**κατ-αλλάσσω**
(Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: [[Jer.48.39|Jer.48:39]] (חָתַת), [[2Ma.1.5|2Ma.1:5]] [[2Mac.7.33|2Mac 7:33]] [[2Mac.8.29|2Mac 8:29]] * ;]
prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, **to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile **(for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., _Notes_, 288; _ICC_ on Ro, l.with; _DCG_, ii, 474, 797), [[2Co.5.18-19;|2Co.5:18-19]] pass [[Rom.5.10|Rom.5:10]], [[2Co.5.20|2Co.5:20]]; of a woman returning to her husband, [[1Co.7.11|1Co.7:11]] (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).†
(AS)

G2643.def:
**κατ-αλλαγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: [[Isa.9.5|Isa.9:5]](4), [[2Ma.5.20|2Ma.5:20]] * ;]
1. exchange.
2. **reconciliation**: [[Rom.5.11|Rom.5:11]] κ. κόσμου, [[Rom.11.15|Rom.11:15]] διακονία τῆς κ., [[2Co.5.18|2Co.5:18]] λόγος τῆς κ., [[2Co.5.19|2Co.5:19]]†
(AS)

G2631.def:
**κατά-κριμα**, -τος, τό
(κατακρίνω),
**penalty **(RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, _Exp._, xv): [[Rom.5.16, 18; 8.1|Rom.5:16, 18 8:1]].†
(AS)

G2659.def:
**κατά-νυξις**, -εως, ἡ
(κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: [[Psa.60.3|Psa.60:3]] (תַּרְעֵלָה), [[Isa.29.10|Isa.29:10]] (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;]
1. a pricking.
2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, **stupefaction**: [[Rom.11.8|Rom.11:8]] (LXX) (see _ICC_, in l; Field, _Notes_, 157).†
(AS)

G2620.def:
**κατα-καυχάομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: [[Zec.10.12|Zec.10:12]] (הָלַךְ hith.), [[Jer.50.11|Jer.50:11]] (עָלַז), [[Jer.50.38|Jer.50:38]] (הָלַל)* ;]
1. **to boast against, exult over**: with genitive, [[Rom.11.18|Rom.11:18]], [[Jas.2.13|Jas.2:13]]; before κατά, with genitive, [[Jas.3.14|Jas.3:14]] (T, om. κατά).
2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, [[Jer.27.38|Jer.27:38]]).†
(AS)

G2693.def:
**κατα-στρώννυμι **
[in LXX: [[Num.14.16|Num.14:16]] (שָׁחַט), [[Job.12.23|Job.12:23]] (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), [[Jdt.4.1-15;|Jdt.4.1-15]] [[Jdt.2.1-28|Jdt.2.1-28]] Mac.4 ;]
1. to strew or spread over.
2. **to lay low, overthrow**: [[1Co.10.5|1Co.10:5]]†
(AS)

G2619.def:
**κατα-καλύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
**to cover up**; mid., **to cover or veil oneself**: [[1Co.11.6|1Co.11:6]] τ. κεφαλήν, [[1Co.11.7|1Co.11:7]]†
(AS)

G2655.def:
**κατα-ναρκάω**, -ῶ
(ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, [[Gen.32.25|Gen.32:25]] (26); without _Heb._ equiv., [[Gen.32.32|Gen.32:32]] (33) [[Job.33.19|Job.33:19]], Dan LXX 11:6*);
1. to cause to grow numb.
2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, [[2Co.11.9; 12.13-14|2Co.11:9 12:13-14]]; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).†
(AS)

G2676.def:
**κατ-άρτισις**, -εως, ἡ
(καταρτίζω),
**a strengthening, making fit**: in ethical sense, [[2Co.13.9|2Co.13:9]]†
(AS)

G2684.def:
**κατα-σκοπέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[4Ki.10.3|4Ki.10:3]], [[1Ch.19.3|1Ch.19:3]] (רָגַל pi.), [[1Ma.5.38|1Ma.5:38]] (A)* ;]
**to view closely, inspect, spy out**: with accusative, [[Gal.2.4|Gal.2:4]]†
(AS)

G2607.def:
**κατα-γινώσκω**
(see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: [[Deu.25.1|Deu.25:1]] (רָשַׁע hi.), [[Pro.28.11|Pro.28:11]] (חָקַר), [[Sir.14.2; 19.5|Sir.14:2 19:5]] * ;]
**to blame, condemn**: with genitive of person(s), [[1Jn.3.20-21;|1Jn.3:20-21]] pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, _Notes_, 188): [[Gal.2.11|Gal.2:11]]†
(AS)

G2671.def:
**κατ-άρα**, -ας, -ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;]
**a curse**: [[Gal.3.10, 13|Gal.3:10, 13]] [[Heb.6.8|Heb.6:8]], [[2Pe.2.14|2Pe.2:14]]; opposite to εὐλογία, [[Jas.3.10|Jas.3:10]] concrete, of Christ, [[Gal.3.13|Gal.3:13]] (see Lft. in l).†
(AS)

G2699.def:
**κατα-τομή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in Sm.: [[Jer.31.37|Jer.31:37]] (κατατέμνω is used in LXX of forbidden mutilations: [[Lev.21.5|Lev.21:5]], al.) ;]
1. incision.
2. **excision, concision, mutilation**: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, [[Php.3.2|Php.3:2]] (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).†
(AS)

G2603.def:
**κατα-βραβεύω**
(βραβεύς, an umpire, cf βραβεῖον)
**to give judg­ment against, condemn **(see Field, _Notes_, 196; Abbott, _Essays_, 104 f.): [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]]†
(AS)

G2689.def:
**κατα-στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστέλλω), [in LXX: [[Isa.61.3|Isa.61:3]] (מַעֲטֶה)* ;]
1. a letting down, checking.
2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour.
3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), **a garment, dress, attire**: [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]] (but see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G2639.def:
**κατα-λέγω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.19.16|Deu.19:16]] (עָנָה), [[2Ma.7.30|2Ma.7:30]] R * ;]
1. **to lay down**; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down.
2. to narrate (LXX, ll. with).
3. **to choose out, hence, to enrol **(as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., [[1Ti.5.9|1Ti.5:9]] (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G2692.def:
**κατα-στροφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστρέφω), [in LXX: [[Job.21.17|Job.21:17]], [[Pro.1.27|Pro.1:27]] (אֵיד), al. ;]
1. **overthrow**: [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]] (WH, om.).
2. Metaphorical, subversion, upsetting (cf. καθαίρεσις, [[2Co.13.10|2Co.13:10]]): [[2Ti.2.14|2Ti.2:14]].†
(AS)

G2688.def:
**κατά-στημα**, -τος, τό
(καθίστημι), in LXX: [[3Ma.5.45|3Ma.5:45]] (-εμα, A) * ;]
1. condition, of health, etc.
2. **demeanour**: [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]] (for exx. see Field, _Notes_, 220).†
(AS)

G2685.def:
**κατά-σκοπος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;]
**a spy**: [[Heb.11.31|Heb.11:31]]†
(AS)

G2610.def:
**κατ-αγωνίζομαι ** depon., "perfective" compound (M, _Pr._, 116);
1. to struggle against.
2. **to conquer, overcome**: [[Heb.11.33|Heb.11:33]]†
(AS)

G2654.def:
**κατ-αν-αλίσκω **
[in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;]
1. to use up, spend.
2. **to consume**: of fire, ptcp., [[Heb.12.29|Heb.12:29]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2635.def:
**κατα-λαλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָבַר ni., pi. ;]
**to speak evil of, rail at**: in cl., with accusative; in LXX,
(a) with genitive,
(b) before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, _Pr._, 65): [[Jas.4.11|Jas.4:11]], [[1Pe.2.12|1Pe.2:12]]; pass., [[1Pe.3.16|1Pe.3:16]],†
(AS)

G2626.def:
**κατα-κλύζω **
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, [[Psa.78.20|Psa.78:20]], al. ;]
**to inundate, deluge**: pass., [[2Pe.3.6|2Pe.3:6]]†
(AS)

G2696.def:
**κατα-σφραγίζω **
[in LXX: [[Job.9.7; 37.7|Job.9:7 37:7]] (חָתַם), [[Wis.2.5|Wis.2:5]] * ;]
**to seal up, secure with a seal**: [[Rev.5.1|Rev.5:1]]†
(AS)
